main_text.head: TYPVS EORVM QVÆ in coena mystica iuxtà spectantur ac inter se cõferuntur.
main_text.p: Homo exterior | τὸ ὑφεστηκός | Homo interior
τὸ ϑεός τι | τὸ αὐπιπρέφοντα[?] | Relatiua | Correlatiua
main_text.head: ¶ Consideratio legis propria.
main_text.p: Deficientia succi vi-talis gi-gnit famem ac sitim corporeâ, quæ nisi sedetur, mors sequitur.
Agnitio peccati & iræ divinæ accendit in nobis famē sitig[?] iustitiæ, quæ nisi resti-guatur, manet nos æterna damnatio.

page.notes: The Greek in the centre column and the diagram rows is transcribed from a small scan and may contain errors; the Greek at the foot of the central column and the middle term of the first pair are uncertain. The word "sitig" at the line end of the right column is doubtful, and so is "restiguatur". The Latin "¶ Con-" at the bottom right is a catchword. The scan shows the neighbouring page's edge at the right, which is not transcribed.
